note: Pull-through park beside I-44 at exit 29, with road noise; a 1.5-acre stocked fishing pond, seasonal pool and game room. --Claude
summary: Operator site (no prices, call to book) + RV Life + Google 4.3 (274): ~43 shaded full-hookup 50A pull-throughs (stored 140 was wrong), showers/sauna, free laundry and WiFi, year-round. Campers report $50/night 2025-26 - at the gate edge, not over.
flags: SITES: stored count 140 (note prose) -> 43 per RV Life's park record; imagery shows six gravel rows of roughly 40-50 pull-throughs. Method reported.

PRICE GATE at the edge: no posted rate ('Call for Reservations and Current Pricing'). RV Life $$ (avg $39) is the price indicator. Dated camper reports all say $50/night: RV Life 6/2026, 4/2026, 2/2026, 12/2025, and a Google review ~2 months old ('well worth the $50 for a comfortable one night stay'). $50 is not over US$50; gateways.py: none within 40 km. Google 4.3 (274) is the tiebreaker and passes. KEEP; no fees written (camper rates may price an entry only when the operator has no web page).

LONG-STAY: the site's reservation form asks 'Short or long term', but this is a transient I-44 stop (reviews are overnighters; RV Life 'cg_55_plus: no'; no monthly rate or lease posted). Tests: (1) $50 - pass at the line; (2) nights sold by phone with no application/lease/membership - no nightly rate on its own site and no booking engine, which is a soft pass resting on reviews of one-night stays; (3) no minimum - pass; (4) reviews show nightly stays, no count - pass; (5) not a home community - pass. KEEP.
WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: the site's own '1.5-acre fishing pond' is under the pond line, and it sits beyond the north row on imagery.

REVIEW: one RV Life review (4/2026) arrived to a 'call' sign and no answer; another (6/2026) says the pool was under construction and the park 'needs a ton of work for $50'. Most recent Google reviews are 5/5.
PIN 37.0785,-94.0955 is at the office driveway, ~10 m from Google's 37.07848,-94.09550; the site rows are 50-150 m north. Fine.
